name: @pipeworx/mcp-cricket

tools.name: current_matches
tools.description: List current and recent cricket matches (Test/ODI/T20) with live scores, teams, venue, and status. Use this for "what cricket matches are live/on right now". Returns match IDs usable with match_info.

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). Each page returns up to 25 matches.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own CricAPI key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: match_scores
tools.description: Get a lightweight feed of live cricket scores across current matches. Returns each match as a compact "team1 vs team2" with running scores and status. Best for quick live cricket score checks.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own CricAPI key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Search for cricket players by name. Returns player IDs, names, and country. Use this to look up a cricketer before fetching more detail.

search.description: Player name to search for, e.g. "Kohli", "Root".

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own CricAPI key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: match_info
tools.description: Get full information and scorecard for a single cricket match (Test/ODI/T20) by its match ID. Returns teams, venue, innings scores, toss, and winner. Get the id from current_matches.

id.description: Match ID, as returned by current_matches.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own CricAPI key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cricket forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cricket pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
